speaker: CALLER
text: Hello, main HDFC bank ke fraud department se bol raha hoon. Aapke account se ek suspicious transaction detect hui hai, twenty four thousand rupees.

speaker: VICTIM
text: Maine to koi transaction nahi ki.

speaker: CALLER
text: Exactly sir, isiliye call kiya. Agar humne ise abhi block nahi kiya to aapka account block ho jayega aur khaata freeze kar diya jayega.

speaker: CALLER
text: Main abhi transaction reverse karta hoon. Aapke registered mobile par ek code aayega. Turant bataiye, warna reversal window band ho jayegi.

speaker: CALLER
text: Haan, message me jo aaya code hai, wo OTP bataiye. Jaldi kijiye, do minute ka time hai.

speaker: VICTIM
text: Yeh to likha hai kisi ko mat batana.

speaker: CALLER
text: Sir wo general warning hoti hai. Main bank se hi bol raha hoon. Aap OTP batao, aur apna UPI PIN bhi confirm kar dijiye taaki main verify kar sakoon.
